finding: SetupAPI records initial Microsoft usbaudio2 installation succeeding, then the configured device-scoped policy refresh through DiInstallDevice receiving PNP_VetoDevice / CR_REMOVE_VETOED. Windows requested a reboot. The installer retained an Auto service, returned 3010 and did not report readiness. The acceptance gate requires actual PCM and service lifecycle, so it correctly failed before those checks.
interpretation: NeedReboot is a documented Windows installation outcome; generic reboot registry flags do not override that native return. This observation does not establish a source regression or a verified post-reboot recovery. Existing policy evidence also shows detach/reconnect without driver refresh fails to preserve output-default selection, so the refresh is not removed to force a pass.
follow_up: One independent hosted installation of these exact bytes is requested to exercise the no-reboot PCM/service branch. No product rebuild, acceptance threshold reduction, automatic shared-host reboot or replacement of this failed record.
